Urban Concierge Brief: SF Bay Area

Tuesday Oct 27 – Thursday Oct 29, 2026 · Snapshot compiled Tue Oct 27, 2026, 6:07 am PT (BayAreaDailySync)

What changed since the last brief (Mon 10:01 pm): no major changes. NWS reissued the Coastal Flood Advisory at 5:41 am Tue with the same tides and end time (Fri Oct 30, 5 pm), Tuesday night's fog was dropped from the forecast, and Thursday is now mostly cloudy, high near 65. No new Caltrans, BART or Muni items.

Weather and alerts

NWS (SF, forecast updated 2:47 am Tue): Tuesday mostly sunny, high near 64, gusts to 18 mph. Tuesday night mostly clear, low around 51. Wednesday mostly sunny, high near 65; Wednesday night partly cloudy, low around 52. Thursday mostly cloudy, high near 65; Thursday night partly cloudy, low around 52.

SF high tides: 7.9 ft at 12:15 pm Tue, 7.7 ft at 12:56 pm Wed, 7.5 ft at 1:43 pm Thu, 7.4 ft at 2:39 pm Fri. Expect flooding of low-lying roads and paths, isolated road closures, and waves farther up the beach.
Source: https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=37.7749,-122.4194

  • Reopened: WB I-80 Bayshore Freeway (5th–15th St, SF) reopened Monday. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-26-i80-wb-bayshore-re-opened · SR-37 between Vallejo and Sonoma reopened at 2:15 am Monday, about 3 hours early. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-26-sr37-reopen
  • SR-29 (Sonoma Blvd), Vallejo, Sequoia Ave to the Solano/Napa line: two lanes closed (one open), Oct 26 – Nov 6, Mon–Thu 9 am–6 pm, Fri 9 am–7 pm. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-23-sr29-daytime-two-lane-closure
  • SR-92/US-101, San Mateo: nightly ramp closures through Fri Oct 30. Tue–Thu nights the WB 92 to SB 101 loop ramp closes 9 pm–5 am. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-23-sr92-us101-nightly-ramp-closures

What's on (each confirmed on an official, venue or ticketing page)

Listings carried from the Mon 10 pm run (not re-opened this run).

1) Noe Valley Night Market: Tue Oct 27, 4:30–8:30 pm. Noe Valley Town Square and 24th St (Vicksburg–Sanchez). Halloween-themed: 40+ food, drink and artist booths, face painting, live music. Free. 24th St closes 2–10 pm; the 48 Muni is rerouted 1:30–10 pm.
https://noemerchants.com/nightmarket-vendors/ · https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/noe-valley-night-market-tuesday-october-27-2026

2) SF Opera, Massenet's Manon: Tue Oct 27, 7:30 pm. War Memorial Opera House, 301 Van Ness. Tickets "starting at $30"; 3 hr 25 min with two intermissions; French with English supertitles. Remaining dates Oct 30 and Nov 1.
https://www.sfopera.com/operas/manon/

3) Sharks vs. Buffalo Sabres: Tue Oct 27, 7:30 pm. SAP Center, San Jose. Ticket prices not checked.
https://www.nhl.com/sharks/schedule

4) Slow Pulp: Tue Oct 27 and Wed Oct 28, 8 pm. The Fillmore, 1805 Geary Blvd. Prices not listed on the venue feed.
https://www.thefillmore.com/shows · https://www.ticketmaster.com/slow-pulp-san-francisco-california-10-27-2026/event/1C0064A49383A7BE

5) Protocols with Andrew Huberman: Wed Oct 28, 7 pm. The Masonic (Nob Hill). Prices not checked.
https://www.sfmasonic.com/shows · https://www.ticketmaster.com/protocols-with-andrew-huberman-san-francisco-california-10-28-2026/event/1C006507D03F9240

6) Mo Welch (comedy): Wed Oct 28, 8 pm. Punch Line Comedy Club, SF. Prices not checked.
https://www.punchlinecomedyclub.com/shows

7) Sharks vs. Vancouver Canucks: Thu Oct 29, 7 pm. SAP Center, San Jose. Ticket prices not checked.
https://www.nhl.com/sharks/schedule

8) Exploratorium After Dark, "Creepatorium": Thu Oct 29, 6–10 pm. Pier 15, SF. The museum's annual Halloween party with Gothicumbia and a science-themed costume contest. Price not checked.
https://www.exploratorium.edu/visit/calendar

Also listed: Cobb's Comedy Club has Tokyo Kanpai Boys (in Japanese) Tue 7:30 pm and Poly Díaz (en español) Wed 7:30 pm. https://www.cobbscomedy.com/shows
No Warriors home games in this window; next is Fri Oct 30 vs. Lakers. https://www.nba.com/warriors/schedule

Where to eat

No Yelp ratings (Yelp blocks automated loads). Descriptions and hours are Michelin's unless noted; price signs are Michelin's.

State Bird Provisions, Fillmore, SF (1529 Fillmore St) · Californian · $$$ · Michelin One Star. Dim sum-style carts of seasonal California small plates, like dumplings, savory pancakes and liver mousse; the menu changes often. Reservations can be hard to get. Dinner daily 5:30–10 pm (10:30 Fri–Sat). Four blocks from the Fillmore for the Slow Pulp shows.
https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/state-bird-provisions

Zuni Café, Hayes Valley/Market St, SF (1658 Market St) · Californian/French · $$$. A San Francisco institution with a copper bar and wood-fired brick oven; Michelin says order oysters, the roast chicken for two and the gâteau Victoire. Tue–Thu dinner 5–9:30 pm (carried). Near the opera house for Manon.
https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/zuni-cafe

Kin Khao, Union Square, SF (55 Cyril Magnin St) · Thai/Californian · $$$. Michelin praises its layered, produce-driven Thai cooking and warns some dishes are very spicy. Its own site: lunch daily 11:30 am–2 pm, dinner Sun–Thu 5:30–9 pm (carried from the last brief). https://www.kinkhao.com/

Nopalito, NoPa, SF (306 Broderick St) · Mexican · $$. Blue-corn fish tacos, chilaquiles verdes, no reservations. Michelin lists 11:30 am–9 pm, except Wednesday 4:30–9 pm (carried). https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/nopalito

Burdell, Oakland (4640 Telegraph Ave) · $$$. Chef Geoff Davis's take on soul food. Closed Mon and Tue, so Wednesday and Thursday only in this window (carried). https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/oakland/restaurant/burdell

Getting around

Muni and cable cars (carried from the last brief): $2.85 single ride with Clipper, MuniMobile or tap-to-pay ($3.00 cash), good 120 minutes. Day pass $5.70. Cable car $9.00. Visitor Passports 1-day $15, 3-day $35, 7-day $47. Youth 18 and under ride Muni free. https://www.sfmta.com/getting-around/muni/fares
Muni reroutes: Tue Oct 27, the 48 skips 24th & Sanchez, Church and Dolores 1:30–10 pm for the Noe Valley Night Market. Coming up: Oct 31 Halloween closures and the Golden Gate Half Marathon Sun Nov 1. https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates

BART:

  • Sun–Thu from 9 pm, expect 30-minute delays between Millbrae, SFO and Daly City for train control work. Leave extra time for late flights. (BART service advisory, reposted 6:05 am Oct 27.)
  • Tue Oct 27 – Fri Oct 30: late-night single tracking on the Yellow Line in Contra Costa County (carried).
  • Coming up: reduced BART-to-OAK service the night of Nov 4, and a bus bridge between 24th St Mission and Daly City Nov 14–15 (carried).
  • SFO: tap a contactless card or Clipper at the gate.
    Sources: https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories · https://www.bart.gov/guide/airport

Bikes and scooters (from the Oct 23 brief, not re-checked): Lyft Bike is $1 to unlock plus $0.19/min classic or $0.49/min ebike, or a $15 day pass. Lime and Spin hold SF permits. No sidewalk riding. https://www.lyft.com/bikes/bay-wheels

SFO cars and rides (from the Oct 23 brief): Rental Car Center via AirTrain Blue Line (24 hours). Lyft and Uber pick up on Level 5 of the Domestic Garage. Taxis at the Arrivals center islands. https://www.flysfo.com/passengers/ground-transportation
